operations.summary: The resolved endpoint discriminant cover R=Q[K2,delta]/(delta^2-K2^2) has normalization Q[K2] plus Q[K2]. operations.title: Benincasa identifies the canonical odd endpoint normalization costalk
operations.body: Entry 1210 types the endpoint specialization object canonically. For R=Q[K2,delta]/(delta^2-K2^2), normalization N=Q[K2]⊕Q[K2] has conductor K2N and coker(Normalization map)=N/R≅Q at K2=0. Deck exchange acts by -1, so the intrinsic object is the anti-diagonal sheet difference, not a selected lift delta=±K2. Finite and infinity endpoints carry the same local odd line under K0↔K4. The remaining source obligation is the ordered endpoint residue/Gysin map and physical relative-chain pairing.
